Emplaced Defense. Hides in a wall, floor or ceiling (DV17 Perception to spot) and pops out for free when triggered; its camera sees even when it's hidden. LL/IR/UV camera; takes any ranged weapon, sold with a Shigure (Extended Magazine, 50 Armor-Piercing), an M2067 Defender (80 Basic) or an Ajax (30 Basic). Fires until the target's dead, gone or shows a pass.

Cost: 7,500eb (Luxury)
HP: 25
CN: 14
Counter: DV17 E/S Tech, 5 min to counter
